description: A native Windows-first, BusyBox-style POSIX shell and utility bundle. One binary, no runtime dependencies.
notes: nemosh is a multicall binary: only the nemosh shim is installed, because two of its applets would shadow Windows commands of the same name and different meaning -- find.exe takes a literal string and a file, and sort.exe is not POSIX sort.
Run 'nemosh --list' to see the bundled applets, and 'nemosh --help' for the command line.
To use an applet directly, add a shim yourself, for example: scoop shim add cat "$(scoop prefix nemosh)\nemosh.exe" cat
